market_outlook.short_term: Markets face elevated volatility driven by US-Iran escalation and bond selloff. Oil likely to trade at premium; equities under pressure from rising yields and inflation fears. Tech/AI names show relative strength but vulnerable to rate spikes. Yen strength and dollar weakness create FX headwinds. Expect 5-8% equity drawdown risk if conflict escalates further. Bond yields likely to test new highs in coming weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally intact (Anthropic, AMD, SLB deals confirm multi-year trajectory). However, rising global rates and geopolitical fragmentation cap multiple expansion. EM selective opportunities (Vietnam, Botswana) offer diversification. Housing affordability and climate risk will continue repricing real estate globally. Healthcare innovation resumes post-CAR-T scare. 6-12 month outlook: cautious constructive with 3-5% equity return potential if geopolitical de-escalation occurs.
